Carrier.reason: “carrier” denotes attention heads or channels that transport positional signals, not the Carrier language; this is a false positive.

Swedish.reason: “Swedish” denotes the language category decoded and evaluated in the country-to-language task, making it part of the experiments.

English.reason: “English” denotes the language of the studied prose corpora and the source language in the evaluated word-translation task.

French.reason: “French” denotes the target language in the evaluated English-to-French word-translation task.
